authority.meaning: Successful discovery and verification do not authorize repository mutation or live adaptive gain writes.
authority.mutation_boundary: Explicit operator action plus a bounded repair or tuning contract and passing verification receipt.
authority.adaptive_boundary: allow_bounded_adaptation remains false unless the operator explicitly changes configuration.
authority.verification_mutation: Verification is read-only for source files; cargo formatting is checked but not applied.
authority.runtime_control_boundary: System telemetry is observational. Process control requires operator selection, explicit connect, verification, and explicit enable.
